name: disaster-recovery-planning
description: Plan disaster recovery. Per critical service: declared RPO (recovery point objective) + RTO (recovery time objective); DR strategy selection (backup-restore / pilot-light / warm-standby / hot-standby / multi-region active-active); backup policy (frequency, retention, testing); failover procedure + runbook; regular DR drills; compliance alignment (business-continuity regulations). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
